items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: I know Bibb Matthews, Bill Matthews.

ctx.x: Do you remember much about Frank Matthew? Frank Matthew? Yeah. He led a band at the Tivoli in Mexico with Charlie Love, Deucin.
Frank Goody. No, I don't know him. I know Bibb Matthews, Bill Matthews.
These guys are all brothers. All brothers, yeah.
